jobs.occupation: Ultrasonic Acoustic Engineer (m/f/d) (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
Ultrasonic Acoustic Engineer (m/f/d)

Sound Propagation, Resonance & Biofouling Prevention

HASYTEC (Ultrasonic Tech GmbH, part of the ERMA TECH Group) develops and markets highly innovative ultrasonic technology that prevents biofouling on fluid-carrying surfaces. Our systems protect more than 300 ships, offshore platforms, and maritime installations worldwide against barnacles, algae, and mussels—efficiently, sustainably, and with minimal maintenance.

To strengthen our development team, we are looking for an Ultrasonic Acoustics Engineer who is passionate about understanding sound propagation, resonance behaviour and ultrasonic systems in complex maritime structures.

You will help develop the next generation of ultrasonic anti-fouling technology.

Our long-term goal is to protect not only piping systems and sea water equipment, but also large ship hull structures through controlled ultrasonic resonance fields.

Your responsibilities include:

- Analyze ultrasonic wave propagation in maritime structures and materials
- Investigate resonance behaviour in piping systems, sea chests, strainers, box coolers, propeller systems and hull structures
- Develop and optimize ultrasonic transducer configurations and installation concepts
- Plan, execute and evaluate laboratory experiments and onboard vessel trials
- Measure vibration behaviour and acoustic transmission using modern test equipment
- Analyze experimental data and derive practical design improvements
- Collaborate with hardware, software and mechanical engineering teams
- Coordinate technical activities with universities and research institutes

Technical Qualifications

- Degree in Physics, Acoustics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field
- Experience in one or more of the following: - Ultrasonics
- Acoustics
- Vibration analysis
- Resonance behaviour
- Signal processing
- Experimental testing
- Experience with laboratory measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers or vibration measurement systems
- Experience in data analysis using Python, MATLAB or similar tools
- Experience in maritime systems, fluid-carrying structures or piezoelectric technology is beneficial but not required
- Analytical and systematic working style
- Curiosity for understanding physical phenomena
- Hands-on mentality and enthusiasm for experimental work
- Ability to bridge theory and practical application
- Team-oriented mindset and initiative
- Our working language is English

What Makes This Role Unique

This is not a standard engineering position.

You will work on challenging acoustic problems involving sound propagation, structural resonance and ultrasonic excitation in real maritime applications.

The role combines physics, experimentation, onboard testing and collaboration with leading research institutions to develop sustainable technologies for the maritime industry.

What we Offer

- Work with a unique technology that contributes to more sustainable shipping
- A combination of laboratory research, practical testing and real-world applications
- High levels of responsibility and influence within a growing company at the forefront of sustainable technology
- Collaboration with international customers, universities and research institutes
- Modern equipment and short decision-making processes
- A technically strong and motivated, multi-professional international team
- employee benefits such as corporate pension schemes, bikeleasing and more

jobs.occupation: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) Are you
ready to design, build, and run a state-of-the-art analytical
chemistry laboratory from the ground up? As a Chemical Quality &
Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be key to establishing
our chemical laboratory infrastructure in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will manage our analytical instruments, set up
testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and
facility chemical systems. Collaborating closely with our advanced
teams in Taiwan and leading a small group of local technicians, you
will directly safeguard the production quality of Europe's newest
premier semiconductor fab! Tasks Lab Infrastructure Setup: Design,
establish, and optimize our on-site chemical lab capacity, process
setups, and analytical capabilities. Instrument Management: Lead the
operation, calibration, and maintenance of high-precision analytical
equipment, with a focus on ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, and Ion
Chromatography (IC). Material Quality Control: Execute routine and
event-triggered monitoring of incoming chemicals and raw materials to
ensure strict compliance with manufacturing standards. Technical
Writing: Define Operational Instructions (OIs) and Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs) for the laboratory environment. Team Leadership:
Supervise, train, and coordinate a small, dedicated group of
laboratory technicians. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with
fab and facility teams to troubleshoot chemical events, support
continuous improvement projects (CIP), and verify tool certifications.
Emergency On-Duty Support: Participate in weekend and night-shift
on-duty rotations to handle urgent chemical safety or quality
escalations. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s
degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a
related scientific discipline. Technical Experience: 0 to 3 years of
hands-on experience in chemical analysis, with deep knowledge of
analytical techniques such as ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, or Ion
Chromatography (IC). Analytical Skillset: Experience in standard
sample preparation, calibration curves, statistical process control
(SPC) data interpretation, and analytical instrument troubleshooting.
Soft Skills: Strong collaborative mindset, intercultural openness,
resilience under pressure, and a structured, detail-oriented approach
to safety and quality. Languages: Fluency in English (written and
spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Prior experience in a semiconductor
manufacturing environment or cleanroom chemical lab management.
Knowledge of European chemical regulations (such as REACH) and safety
standards. Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, R, or SQL) for
analytical data processing. Basic communication skills in German
and/or Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent
employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of
Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center,
gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating
complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training,
while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An
annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports
classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

with internal management and executive supplier representatives.

quality improvements. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or

technical field. Experience: 0 to 3 years of professional experience,

statistical data analysis, or process change control. Interpersonal &

initiative, and the confidence to communicate effectively with
international teams and senior management. Languages: Fluent in
English (written and spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Practical
experience in semiconductor fabrication operations, process
engineering, or physical/chemical laboratory analysis. Familiarity
with structured problem-solving methods (e.g., 8D, 5 Whys) and
supplier auditing. Basic conversational skills in German and/or
Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent employment
contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's
leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide
you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your
start in Dresden. Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer
Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved
in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on
training, while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health &
Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for

Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized

jobs.occupation: Biologe (m/w/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research withexcellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranksfirst among universityhospitalsin North Rhine-Westphalia andsecond nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The arbovirus research group of PD Dr. Beate Kümmerer at the Institute of Virology at the University Hospital Bonn (Germany) is looking for a highly motivated

PhD student (m/f/d)

to join our team and explore the fascinating biology of orthoflavivirus-host interaction in mosquitoes and vertebrates. The PhD position (65% E13 salary according to DFG recommendations), initially limited to three years, is advertisedwithin the framework of the DFG-funded CRC/Transregio 237 “Nucleic Acid Immunity” and is to be filled by January 2027.

The position is offered on a fixed-term basis until December 31, 2029.
Mosquito-borne RNA viruses, such as dengue, yellow fever, and Zika virus, cause severe disease outbreaks worldwide. As climate change drives the spread of mosquito vectors, the regions affected by these viruses continue to expand. Orthoflaviviruses have evolved multiple strategies to evade innate immune recognition, thereby promoting viral replication and pathogenesis. The project aims to elucidate how viral RNA structures and RNA modifications shape innate immune recognition. A particular focus will be the identification of mosquito proteins that recognize viral cap0 RNA and the characterization of viral immune antagonists in both mosquito and vertebrate hosts. We hope to gain mechanistic insights into virus-host interactions that support the development of innovative antiviral therapies and sustainable vector control strategies.

Methods: Molecular biology methods, cell culture and virological methods, RNA-protein and protein-protein interaction studies, gene expression analyses, cellular knock-down, as well as research involving mosquitoes.

Master’s degree in life sciences
Enthusiasm for research in a collaborative environment
Commitment to the research project
Profound knowledge in basic molecular biological methods and cell culture
Experience in virology and/or protein-RNA/protein interaction studies would be ideal
Eligibility, willingness and physical fitness to work in a biosafety lev el (BSL) 3 laboratory
Interest in working with live mosquitoes
Motivation to learn new methods
Fluent oral and written English

A 3-year PhD position (65% TV-L E13) with strong mentoring and integration into a high-profile research network (CRC/Transregio 237)
An interdisciplinary research environment at one of Germany’s top universities
A highly collaborative research team

Access to further education in university and non-university courses
Integration into the Bonn International Graduate School (BIGS) Immunosciences and Infection

Responsible and diverse: A position with plenty of room for creativity and responsibility within a supportive and collegial team

Fair compensation: Pay according to the TV-L collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme

Family-friendly flexibility: Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave

Smart commuting: Excellent connection to the SWB public transport network

jobs.occupation: Senior Specialist Digital Marketing (m/f/x) (Performance-Marketing-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
PVH is one of the most successful fashion and lifestyle companies in the world. Our brand portfolio includes the iconic brands CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, with more than 30,000 employees operating in over 40 countries. PVH stands for development and innovation like no other company with the ongoing digitalization and integration of all channels.

One of PVH's greatest strengths is our people and our shared desire to create an inclusive work environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard. Together, we are committed to a more diverse and fair fashion industry to drive sustainable change both at PVH and in our industry.

The head office for the DACH and EEC markets, covering 13 countries with more than 2,700 employees, is in Düsseldorf and is the main location of around 500 employees.

A day in the life of a Senior Specialist Digital Marketing (m/f/x):

- Own the digital marketing strategy and execution for one of our key Pure Player partners across TOMMY HILFIGER and CALVIN KLEIN
- Plan and execute data-driven digital marketing campaigns that balance brand objectives with commercial priorities
- Translate global marketing calendars into tailored partner marketing plans to deliver best-in-class consumer experiences
- Track, analyze, and optimize campaign performance using KPIs and market insights to drive continuous improvement
- Build strong relationships with Pure Player partners and collaborate with local, regional, and global stakeholders
- Identify market trends, optimize processes, and drive innovative digital marketing initiatives

What do we need from you? You have:

- University degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or a comparable qualification
- 3+ years of experience in Digital Marketing, eCommerce, eCommerce Marketing, or a Digital Marketing Agency
- Experience working with Pure Players, online marketplaces, or wholesale eCommerce partners is a plus
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, campaign planning, and performance marketing
- Analytical mindset with experience using marketing tools and KPIs to drive business decisions
- Ability to balance brand objectives with commercial priorities
- Creative, proactive, and solution-oriented approach with strong stakeholder management skills
- Excellent written and spoken English and German

What you can expect from us:

- A smart working model (hybrid), including flex office solutions, a work from anywhere concept and meeting-free Fridays
- Lead Yourself. Lead Together. Lead the Way. Our PVH Leadership Behaviors empower everyone to lead — whether a team, a project or through individual expertise
- A strong culture of development with extensive training and learning opportunities via our PVH University
- A wide range of employee benefits, including employee discounts, mobility offers, internal sports classes and other initiatives

RESOLV is a world-leading interdisciplinary research project in Solvation Science awarded as a Cluster of Excellence by the German Excellence Strategy. Within RESOLV, more than 200 scientists at six institutions in the Ruhr area, covering experimental chemistry, theory, chemical physics, and chemical engineering, investigate how solvents are involved in the control, mediation and regulation of chemical reactions and processes. The research focuses on three main areas: I) Charge and Electron Transfer: The Solvent in Action, II) Solvent Design for Chemical Processes, and III) Tuning Stability and Homogeneity. RESOLV’s mission stretches from fundamental research to applications and products. For more information, please refer to our website (www.solvation.de).

RESOLV has established a structured postdoctoral training platform with emphasis on both individual research training and career coaching in academia, industry, and entrepreneurship. Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-29

Your tasks:

- As postdoctoral researcher in Area III, you will contribute to the design of highly stable formulations, preventing phase changes while maintaining the functionality of active molecules, such as chemical entities or biomolecules. Drawing on the remarkable influence of the liquid environment, RESOLV aims to improve the applicability of hydrophobic pharmaceuticals by crafting customized mesophase structures to overcome the limitations of low solubility and bioavailability. Further major goals are to uncover the mechanism by which enzymes become more active in the specific solvent environment of liquid condensates induced by liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) and to map local hydration changes and LLPS even in living cells.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position on Privacy and Security of AI-as-a-Service Systems (m,f,x) for 3 years with 39,83 hours (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1

PhD Position on Privacy and Security of AI-as-a-Service Systems (m,f,x) for 3 years with 39,83 hours per week, TV-L E13

The Ruhr area, one of Europe's largest metropolitan regions, provides attractive career opportunities for outstanding scientists and scholars from around the world. In 2021, Ruhr University Bochum, TU Dortmund University, and the University of Duisburg-Essen established the Research Alliance Ruhr to consolidate their pioneering international research on humanity's most pressing challenges. This alliance encompasses four research centers and a college, marking a new chapter in our enduring collaboration as the University Alliance Ruhr (UA Ruhr), a vibrant community of 14,000 researchers and 120,000 students located in the heart of Germany. Join us and contribute to cutting-edge research at RC Trust, where innovation meets real-world impact. As part of the Research Alliance Ruhr, the Research Center for Trustworthy Data Science and Security unites the expertise of its member universities to bridge the gaps between Psychology & Social Sciences, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Data Science & Statistical Learning, and Cybersecurity & Privacy. The Research Alliance Ruhr, a collaborative initiative by the three major universities in the Ruhr area, was established through the Ruhr Conference. It encompasses four research centers: "One Health Ruhr," "Chemical Sciences and Sustainability," "Trustworthy Data Science and Security," and "Future Energy Materials and Systems." Additionally, it includes a "College for Social Sciences and Humanities." The Research Alliance Ruhr is appointing up to 50 research professors and offers numerous positions for research assistants. Join us in creating innovations for the future within Europe's most densely populated yet greenest university landscape, where a diverse range of scientific and industrial partners are readily accessible. The position is embedded in the collaborative research project DAISY – Data Protection and Employee Interests in AI-as-a-Service Systems, funded by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) under the program "Plattform Privatheit – IT Security Protects Privacy and Supports Democracy." Organizations increasingly purchase AI capabilities as ready-made cloud services (AI-as-a-Service, AIaaS) without any insight into the underlying architectures, data flows, or security mechanisms. DAISY investigates how such systems can be adopted in a privacy-compliant and employee-centered way, combining computer science, psychology, and organizational science. Together with the University of Duisburg-Essen, Witten/Herdecke University, and the Bochum Economic Development Agency as application partner, the consortium examines the mental models that decision-makers and employees hold of AIaaS, contrasts them with the actual technical properties of these systems, and derives measures to bring the two into alignment.

This position covers the technical perspective of the project at Ruhr University Bochum: characterizing real-world AIaaS systems empirically, condensing their privacy- and security-relevant properties into risk profiles, and developing and evaluating privacy-compliant AIaaS configurations built from open-source components. The work follows a human-centered perspective on security and privacy, combining technical analysis with empirical research on the people who use these systems. The position is designed to lead to a doctorate and is embedded in the graduate structures of RC Trust. This is an on-site position in Bochum; regular presence at the university is expected. Remote work is possible on individual days by arrangement, but the position cannot be carried out fully remotely.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 36 Monate
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-10-05

Your tasks:

Within the project, you will shape your own research agenda around the following tasks:

- Survey the technical state of the art on privacy and security architectures of AIaaS in a systematic literature review
- Empirically characterize commercially available AIaaS systems with respect to their privacy- and security-relevant properties, and systematize the findings into risk profiles
- Design, implement, and iteratively refine privacy-compliant AIaaS configurations from open-source components, and test them on real use cases with our application partner
- Evaluate these configurations with respect to security, performance, and scalability
- Collaborate closely with partners from psychology, organizational science, and practice, and make technical findings accessible to non-expert audiences
- Publish research results at leading international venues in security, privacy, and human-centered security

Your profile:

- Master's degree in computer science, IT security, or a closely related technical field (or shortly before completion)
- Solid programming skills (e.g., Python) and practical experience with web APIs and cloud services
- Hands-on experience with large language models — for instance, self-hosting open-weight models, building LLM-based pipelines, or working with commercial provider APIs
- First research experience in security and privacy
- Demonstrable interest in interdisciplinary research, and in working with companies as practice partners
- High proficiency in English, both written and spoken, for scientific publications and presentations
- Working proficiency in German (at least B2, or willingness to reach this level early in the project): the project is carried out with German partner organizations and reporting to the funding agency is in German
